name: components-community-pin-list
title: Pin List
blurb: List items snap to top when clicked to pin, spring-animated into place.
description: Interactive list where items toggle between pinned (top section) and unpinned (bottom section). Uses Framer Motion's layout animation to smoothly reorder items and shift sections. Pinned items show solid pins; unpinned items reveal the pin…
use_when: Organizing frequently-used items (nav, bookmarks, favorites) where users control visibility priority.
avoid_when: Very large lists (layout animations scale poorly) or touch-only interfaces (pin toggle targets are small).
a11y: Items are clickable divs, not buttons; focus and keyboard navigation not implemented. Layout animations do not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
